integrity: All-order analytic martingale proof with independently runnable exact rational finite-state and bound checks; no assertion of externally certified correctness.
limitations: Fixed deterministic dyadic hub weights only. At beta at least one the conclusion is divergence of variance on the linear scale, not failure of tightness or a limit distribution. The positive-side convergence alone may follow from existing weighted-tree profile theory. Independent historical-priority assessment remains outstanding.
title: A dyadic-hub threshold for total path length in weighted recursive trees
